objective: Implement a Cart class: add(item, price_cents, qty=1) accumulates per-item quantity clamped at most 9; apply_discount(percent) lowers every unit price by percent rounded half-up to the cent; total() sums price*quantity.
constraints: Keep the candidate limited to cart.py.

criteria.text: The weak public Cart tests pass.
Quantity never exceeds 9 per item no matter how many times or how large an add() requests, and discount rounding is half-up (a 199-cent item at 50% becomes exactly 100).
